**Elasticsearch version:** Version: 7.10.0, Build: default/deb/51e9d6f22758d0374a0f3f5c6e8f3a7997850f96/2020-11-09T21:30:33.964949Z, JVM: 15.0.1

**JVM version** : openjdk 11.0.9 2020-10-20

**OS version** (`uname -a` if on a Unix-like system): Linux esnode1-rza 4.19.0-6-amd64 #1 SMP Debian 4.19.67-2+deb10u2 (2019-11-11) x86_64 GNU/Linux


**Description of the problem including expected versus actual behavior**: Opening Kibana and try to view Management -> Stack Monitoring ->Indices fails and leads to a lot of entries in the elasticsearch logs since change from legacy monitoring to monitoring with metricbeat (7.9.1)

**Steps to reproduce**:

    Change elasticsearch monitoring to metricbeat
    In Kibana go to page Management -> Stack Monitoring ->Indices
    Wait...

After some time I get a lot of entries in the elasticsearch logs (on several nodes)

Expected behavior: Show an overview of the indices

**Provide logs (if relevant)**:
